name: collect_dna_snapshot
description: Captures a Device DNA Snapshot of installed software, persists it to SQLite, and returns the newly created snapshot.

name: get_devices
description: Lists all known devices recorded in the local database.

name: get_snapshots
description: Lists all Device DNA Snapshots ordered newest-first by captured_at.

name: get_snapshot
description: Fetches a single snapshot by id, or null if no snapshot matches.

name: get_software_inventory
description: Lists the software inventory items for a given snapshot, ordered by name.

name: get_config_items
description: Lists the system-configuration items (startup, services, scheduled tasks) for a given snapshot, ordered by kind then name.

name: get_timeline_events
description: Lists all Performance Timeline change events derived from diffing consecutive snapshots, ordered newest-first by occurred_at then category and title.

name: create_restore_plan
description: Generates a restore plan from a snapshot's software inventory (one step per item, ordered by name), persists it, and returns the new plan.

name: get_restore_plans
description: Lists all restore plans ordered newest-first by created_at.

name: get_restore_plan_steps
description: Lists the steps of a restore plan, ordered by order_index ascending.

name: run_restore
description: Executes a restore plan. mode defaults to dryRun; install opts into real WinGet.

name: get_restore_jobs
description: Lists all restore jobs ordered newest-first by started_at.

name: get_restore_step_results
description: Lists the per-step results for a restore job.

name: collect_health_sample
description: Samples current CPU, memory, and disk usage for the local device, computes a 0-100 HealthScore, persists the sample to SQLite, and returns it.

name: get_health_samples
description: Lists all health samples ordered newest-first by captured_at.

name: get_latest_health_sample
description: Fetches the most recent health sample, or null if none have been recorded.

name: get_health_alerts
description: Lists all health alerts ordered unacknowledged-first then newest by created_at.

name: acknowledge_alert
description: Marks a health alert acknowledged.

name: scan_crash_events
description: Scans the OS event log for crash/stability events, classifies them, persists new ones idempotently, and returns the full list newest-first.

name: get_crash_events
description: Lists all recorded crash events ordered newest-first by occurred_at.

name: export_setup
description: Builds a portable, SHA-256-checksummed setup bundle from a stored snapshot.

name: import_setup
description: Imports a setup bundle (verifying its checksum) as a new local snapshot.

name: run_diagnosis
description: Runs offline diagnosis with query intent routing over multi-engine context.

name: get_diagnosis_sessions
description: Lists all diagnosis sessions ordered newest-first by created_at.

name: get_diagnosis_findings
description: Lists the findings for a diagnosis session, ordered by position.

name: get_sync_status
description: Returns the local cloud-sync queue status.

name: trigger_sync
description: Attempts to drain the cloud-sync queue and returns the updated status.

name: get_dashboard_intelligence
description: Aggregated intelligence for the ops dashboard (health, findings, top processes).

name: list_intelligence_findings
description: Lists durable intelligence findings from domain engines.

name: dismiss_finding
description: Dismisses an intelligence finding.

name: list_action_audit
description: Lists action audit entries newest first.

name: propose_safe_cleanup
description: Records a dry-run safe cleanup preview (no file deletion).

name: list_processes
description: Lists live processes with risk scoring, sorted by memory then CPU.

name: scan_storage
description: Depth-limited storage scan with categories and findings.

name: get_latest_storage_scan
description: Returns the most recent storage scan.

name: get_storage_items
description: Lists storage items for a scan, largest first.

name: search_all
description: FTS search across software, config, crashes, timeline, and findings.

name: rebuild_search_index
description: Rebuilds the local FTS search index from on-device data.

name: collect_hardware_sample
description: Samples temps/GPU/SMART and persists.

name: get_latest_hardware_sample
description: Latest hardware sample.

name: get_hardware_samples
description: Recent hardware samples.

name: scan_drivers
description: Scan and score installed drivers.

name: list_drivers
description: List last driver inventory.

name: scan_security
description: Behavioral security scan.

name: list_security_findings
description: List security findings.

name: dismiss_security_finding
description: Dismiss a security finding.

name: list_vault_entries
description: List recovery vault entries.

name: create_restore_point
description: Create Windows System Restore point.

name: create_dna_vault_backup
description: Vault latest DNA as .dlsetup.

name: create_directory_image
description: Recursive directory image into vault.

name: get_agent_status
description: Latest agent heartbeat.

name: ping_agent
description: Record UI agent heartbeat.

name: execute_safe_cleanup
description: Delete allowed temp/cache files after confirm.

name: get_copilot_status
description: Whether xAI LLM is configured.
